articles.summary: New Lineup of US Foods Exclusive Brands Products Help Operators Serve Profit-Boosting, On-Trend Italian Menu Experiences with Less Back-of-House Labor US Foods Holding Corp. (NYSE: USFD), one of America’s largest foodservice distributors, today announced the launch of Fall 2026 Scoop™, a collection of 14 US Foods Exclusive Brands products inspired by the time-honored standards of Italian cooking. These new products feature authentic ingredients in labor-saving formats with flexible applications, designed to help operators bring innovative, Italian-inspired flavors to life across their menu. US Foods 2026 Fall Scoop From bar and grill to casual dining concepts, Italian-inspired dishes remain a mainstream global flavor platform across American menus.
